migration_notes: Source provider: proprietary wrapper over OpenAI (usage-heavy function-calling and streaming).
Compatibility concerns: function call schema differences; Redwood hosted maps but some nested tool outputs require minor prompt refactors.
Prompt parity: tokenization differences caused reranking reorder for ~6% of test prompts — chasing prompt-templating and stop token tuning.
Embedding migration: existing vector dim 1536; evaluated Redwood-hosted model dims — minor transform needed, index rebuild estimated 12 hours for 1M docs.
Regressions: regression harness run (1k prompts) flagged edge-case hallucinations in multi-step retrieval flows; SE recommended temperature / decoding changes.
Performance: Hosted p95 latency for chat (<=256 tokens) measured 240ms vs baseline 210ms; cost per 1k tokens ~24% lower on Redwood hosted.
Routing/fallback: need compatibility layer to gracefully fallback to legacy provider during Dedicated rollout for unruly prompts — suggested canary routing policy.
Operational: rate-limit behavior differs — engineering to add adaptive backoff for bursts; caching prefix recommended by Redwood Optimize.
Acceptance criteria for go/no-go: <=5% QA regression on reranker MRR, <=30% cost delta reduction, SSO test pass, DPA signed.
pain_points: Rising per-token costs and unpredictable spend during sales spikes
